text:
Eli C.: short sync: Willow wants a DSA for telemetry + a beta benchmark acceptance checklist before we move to the next hardware validation stage. can we scope this here?
Sam T.: yes. proposed scope: 1) aggregated perf metrics (p50/p95/p99), 2) per-gpu power/temperature samples, 3) kv-cache hit/miss ratios, 4) worker RSS and ephemeral spikes, 5) sample sanitized stack traces. no raw request/response bodies.
Nina L.: legal asks that the DSA explicitly call out retention windows and redaction rules. propose 90-day retention for shared artifacts, raw logs kept in our bucket only. also need a clause for incident-level deep-dive requests (signed SOW/DSA amendment).
Taylor PM: for benchmarks, Willow needs acceptance criteria. suggest: p99 <= 120ms for batch=1 at 1024 seq on their reference node, and <5% tail regressions between runs. also baseline token quality checks (perplexity within 3% of our reference).
Sam T.: agree on perf numbers but add a minimal stability requirement: 10-minute run with <2 OOMs and 0 silent-fail exits. tag runs `willow-eap-accept-v1`.
Eli C.: data format: they prefer size-efficient payloads. we will stream protobuf to s3 and provide a binary artifact plus a manifest JSON. still ok for legal?
Nina L.: OK with proto as long as manifest contains schema version and the proto descriptors. include an integrity checksum and signed access token TTL in the DSA appendix.
Taylor PM: SI integration note: post-EAP we plan a reference connector for Willow hardware in our marketplace offering. do not create any buyer-facing listing until compliance + joint PR cleared. put a marketplace embargo flag in the partner record.
Sam T.: technical runbook items for lab team: 1) grant `willow-eap` bucket access via cross-account IAM role; 2) KMS key alias `alias/willow-eap`; 3) agent config: `--payload=proto --sample-interval=30 --kv-capture=on --sanitize=true`; 4) bench harness under `benchmarks/willow-eap/v1`; 5) capture telemetry manifest and upload to `s3://willow-eap/manifest/`.
Eli C.: we'll provide a short repro script (python) that exercises the 99th-percentile path and produces a minimized trace to reproduce the spike. good to include in the DSA appendix as "repro artifact".
WillowLegalBot: DSA draft WIL-DSA-2026-v1 uploaded. Retention: 90 days for shared artifacts. Raw telemetry access requires separate signed agreement. Redaction: request for account IDs to be hashed.
Taylor PM: scheduling: propose two lab windows next week: Tue 13:00 PT (validation run) and Thu 09:00 PT (follow-up with Willow eng). who can own Tue run?
Sam T.: I can run Tue 13:00 PT. will spin up the harness, collect the manifest, and post run artifacts to the shared drive.
Eli C.: I'll be on Thu to walk through SI integration design and marketplace embargo checklist.
Nina L.: I'll review the DSA and push comments by EOD Monday. include the redaction rules and the process for emergency raw data requests.
Taylor PM: owners: Sam - bench + artifacts, Eli - SI + marketplace plan, Nina - DSA, Taylor - partner PM & comms. please update the partner tracker with these owners.
Sam T.: quick ops question: Willow asked if we can provide a short live telemetry stream for 10 minutes for their perf team. we should limit to aggregated stream with 1s buckets, correct?
Nina L.: legal fine with aggregated live stream for troubleshooting. must be covered by the DSA and access tokens expire at session end. no raw payload streaming.
Eli C.: ok pushing the runbook and repro to `redwood-internal/partnerships/willow-eap/` and will link here once uploaded.
Taylor PM: thanks all. please flag any blockers. we'll reconvene in this thread after Tue's run. :white_check_mark:
